property_summary: For any encoded clone-argument tail where the collateral and debt token addresses differ, C.collateral() must return the address stored at immutable-arg offset 0x14; the mutant reads offset 0x28 and so returns the debt token instead for some fuzzed input.
change_summary: Read the immutable arg at offset 0x28 (the debt token) instead of 0x14, so collateral() returns the debt token address.
